def: properly, something kept out of sight, i.e. a lad

occurrences.text: And the king said, Enquire thou whose son the stripling is.
But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows are beyond thee; go thy way: for the Lord hath sent thee away.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
